translations.web: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
translations.bsb: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
translations.kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
translations.asv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
